update_message: A brand-new animated setup guide that walks you through every step, plus a steadier accessibility service, safer payment-app pausing and silent operation. Your keys, settings and history stay.

texts.hero_subtitle: Tap any text box in any app. The OnlyFlow logo appears next to it. Hold it, speak, release - your words are pasted.
texts.recording_subtitle: Classes, calls, YouTube, your own thoughts
texts.no_key_title: Add an API key to start
texts.no_key_message: OnlyFlow runs on your own AI key. Open Settings → AI keys and paste a key from OpenRouter, Gemini, OpenAI or Groq (these can also hear speech).
texts.offline_message: Your internet connection has a problem, please connect to the internet. Your recording is saved and will be processed automatically.
texts.summary_ready: Your earlier recording's summary is ready.
texts.blocked_audio_message: This app blocks internal audio. Turn on 'Speaker audio through microphone' in Recording Mode sources.
texts.hero_subtitle_tap: Tap any text box in any app. The OnlyFlow logo appears next to it. Tap it, speak, tap again - your words are pasted.
